growth_problem.statement: The growth problem in Japan is the modest pace of a high-income economy: 0.8 percent a year over the last decade (structural-peer median 1.4); growth diagnostics is built for economies far from the income frontier, so its readings here call for care. GDP per capita growth over 2016–2025 averaged 0.8 percent a year (2006–2025: 0.8; structural-peer median 1.4), 0.2 standard deviations below the convergence expectation and ranked 8 of 11 among structural peers. GDP per capita is at its peak to date (2025). Growth since 1990 shows no lasting shift of 2 points or more: it averaged 1.0 percent a year over 1990–2025. Investment (gross fixed capital formation to GDP) is 1.0 standard deviation above expectation given income at 27.8 percent of GDP; the private-public split is unavailable in prototype (IMF Investment and Capital Stock Dataset not ingested). Gross savings is 0.5 standard deviations above expectation given income; the current account balance is 4.4 percent of GDP and net FDI inflows are 0.6 percent of GDP. Structural change (G9) is not computed in the prototype. Exports to GDP is 1.2 standard deviations below expectation given income, and economic complexity is 1.2 standard deviations above expectation (the complexity gap). The relevant question is therefore: what limits productivity growth in an economy already near the income frontier. Provisional top-split reading: investment without finance (real lending rate t = -0.6, real private credit growth 0.9 percent, investment t = 1.0).

top_split.label: investment without finance
top_split.reading: High investment despite thin finance: likely public or FDI-led; check private investment separately

structural.rule: structural: 10 nearest by Euclidean distance in z-scores of log_gdppc_ppp, log_population, resource_rents (diagonal Mahalanobis), with a landlocked mismatch adding 1 to the squared distance (one sd of a continuous feature); micro-states below 300000 excluded; high-income economies included; fragile and conflict-affected economies excluded; candidates with an income observation before 2023 excluded

regional.rule: regional: same region (East Asia & Pacific); income groups within 0 step(s) of High income until at least 6; capped at 15 nearest by log GDP per capita (PPP)

aspirational.rule: aspirational: GDP per capita (PPP) in 2000 within ±30% of the target's current 47717 and average growth since ≥ 3% a year; up to 10 by growth
